title: DataFiles
description:
`data.toml`: the files the project uses from outside it, such as CORS
observations and precise orbits, as fetched into the shared download
cache. It records exactly which files were used, by hash, and the
attribution their licences ask for.

attributions.description: What reports must say about the data, word for word.

file.description: The files, sorted by what they're for, then by name.

schema.description: The schema version: 1 (`SCHEMA`), raised only when a migration is needed.

DataFile.description: A file from outside the project.

fetched.description: When it was downloaded, in UTC.

note.description:
Anything to know, such as rapid orbits used because finals weren't
out yet.

purpose.description:
What it's for, such as `SYDN observations, 2025-06-15 03:05:00 to
2025-06-15 05:15:00 GPS`.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, in hex: its key in the download cache.

site_log.description:
For a CORS file: its RINEX header against the station's site log,
`agrees` or what differs.

source.description: The source's id in the jurisdiction pack.
